done_when: The synced Forge skill tells the agent, the first time each of these happens for a person, to add one plain sentence saying what just happened and what they can do next: a story plan shown for approval, a cold read finding, a part starting, a pull request ready, a merge, a prototype demo, sign-off; never repeating it, never naming commands unless asked; a test checks each moment through forge sync and forge init
why: People using Forge through the agent don't learn how Forge works, because the agent does each step without telling them what just happened or what they can do next
